question.body:
The function $f$ is defined by $f(x)= sqrt(25 - x^(2))$ for $- 5 <= x <= 5$.

(a) Find $f'(x)$.

(b) Write an equation for the line tangent to the graph of $f$ at $x = - 3$.

(c) Let $g$ be the function defined by $g(x)= cases(f(x) & " for "- 5 <= x <= - 3, x + 7 & " for "- 3 < x <= 5 .)$ Is $g$ continuous at $x = - 3$ ? Use the definition of continuity to explain your answer.

(d) Find the value of $integral_(0)^(5) x sqrt(25 - x^(2)) d x$.
